description:
• Brand introduction: Organzae is your gateway to the world of elegance and sophistication. Inspired by the rich heritage of Organza fabric, we've redefined the way you experience fashion. Our journey begins in the Mughal era and continues into the modern age, where we've made Organza more versatile than ever. We specialize in crafting hand-woven pieces that beautifully blend the opulence of Mughal heritage with contemporary charm. With a keen eye for aesthetics, we offer ready-to-wear and evening wear that effortlessly elevates your style. Organzae is about making you feel regal, without any compromise on comfort. It's not just clothing; it's an expression of pure elegance. 


• Product description: We are a startup based in New Delhi. Our product is made from high quality materials- mostly through Organza fabric. We have listed it as a premium product as it takes 18-30 hours for each product to be finished. We are currently only making hand embriodared products. They are for evening ready to wear (Pret) clothes. They are meant to be of loose fitting- only two sizes are avaliable (Small-Medium) & (Large-Extra Large). We have made them of loose fittings as the Indian market (Mother's & ladies) do not usually have thin figure. The manufacturing cost of these products are high as it is hand made and fabric is imported and expensive. Intricate hand craftsmanship is involved using dabka-naqshi technique and more. 


• USP (Unique Selling Point): Hand Embriodary on all of our products. The product quality is extremely high. We only use pure fabrics to make our products long lasting and comfortable to use. We are only focusing towards affordable luxury in evening ready to wear clothes.

- Our clothes are in vibrant colors.

-PRET- Ready to Wear: Finished Product.


• Payment terms: Online payments to be made.


• Other information: The product is genuinly of very high quality and finish. Our packaging is also giving premium quality finish.
name: Organzae
